deepseek-fork.config.title: DeepSeek Cache-Aware
deepseek-fork.config.baseUrl.description: DeepSeek API base URL. Defaults to official DeepSeek API endpoint.
deepseek-fork.config.maxTokens.descripti: Maximum number of output tokens per request. Set to 0 to use the API default (no limit). Useful for controlling costs.
deepseek-fork.config.experimental.stabil:
**Experimental**: improve DeepSeek context-cache hit rate by pre-activating available tools.
- When the enabled tools list changes across turns, this may improve DeepSeek context-cache hit rate.
- Requests will include more function definitions, so input tokens may increase. Cache-hit input tokens are billed at a lower price, but still count toward usage.
- This may add internal preflight tool calls to the current Copilot chat history. If you switch to another model in the same conversation, that model provider may reject or mishandle the replayed history. Start a new chat if model switching behaves unexpectedly.

Use [Configure Tools](command:workbench.action.chat.configureTools) to **view and manage** your tool list:

- 64 or fewer enabled tools: usually no need to enable this unless the tool list still changes across turns.
- More than 128 enabled tools: not recommended. DeepSeek supports at most 128 functions in one `tools` request. Consider disabling tools you rarely use.
deepseek-fork.config.debugMode.descripti:
Controls what diagnostic information DeepSeek Copilot writes. Token usage is always reported to Copilot regardless of this setting.

- **Minimal** — Token usage only. No diagnostic logs or request dumps.
- **Metadata** — Privacy-safe diagnostic metadata (request hashes, prefix overlap, tool schema changes). Does not contain prompt text — safe to share in public issue reports. View with [`DeepSeek Cache-Aware: Show Logs`](command:deepseek-fork.showLogs).
- **Verbose** — Complete request payloads written to disk for local debugging. **Warning: contains sensitive prompt content.** View with [`DeepSeek Cache-Aware: Open Request Dumps Folder`](command:deepseek-fork.openRequestDumpsFolder).
deepseek-fork.config.debugMode.minimal.d: Token usage only. No diagnostic logs or dumps.
Privacy-safe metadata. Safe to share publicly. View with `DeepSeek Cache-Aware: Show Logs`.
deepseek-fork.config.debugMode.verbose.d: ⚠️ Contains sensitive prompt content. For local debugging only.
deepseek-fork.config.modelIdOverrides.de: Override the API model ID sent for each DeepSeek model. Defaults are prefilled with official DeepSeek IDs; change them only when using a compatible third-party API that uses different model names.
API model ID for DeepSeek V4 Pro
deepseek-fork.config.visionModel.descrip: Vision Proxy used by DeepSeek V4 Pro. Images are input only — neither model generates images. When unset, auto mode uses DeepSeek Flash as the proxy. Configure a different VS Code model or API endpoint with [Configure Vision Proxy](command:deepseek-fork.setVisionModel).
deepseek-fork.config.visionPrompt.descri:
Prompt used by the Vision Proxy to describe image attachments. It does not affect DeepSeek Flash's direct image input. Clearing it falls back to the built-in default.

[Configure Vision Proxy](command:deepseek-fork.setVisionModel)
deepseek-fork.config.modelIdOverrides.de: Override the API model id sent to DeepSeek for this model.
